authorization: Direct current user request: one bounded suffix+native behavior check, same24 bodies and exact S03 candidates. Stop afterwards.

ATTN_SAE.encoding: native encoder(x), ReLU, Top32; active iff selected z>0; no input normalization, no decoder bias subtraction

MLPIN_SAE.encoding: native encoder(x), ReLU, Top32; active iff selected z>0; no input normalization, no decoder bias subtraction
MLPIN_SAE.hook: block27.mlp forward_pre_hook actual input after residual addition and post_attention_layernorm

candidate_selection: NONE: reuse exact ordered S03 lists and discovery directions; no threshold/ranking changes
behavior: sum conditional logprob of all candidate tokens, including leading-space class token and final period; no length/neutral-prior correction. P/N no correct label.
score_delta: S_cat - S_dog; max sum wins; exact tie uses cat first, recorded
normalization: Per each exact frozen named list H1_common, H1_added_cat, H1_added_dog, H2: q_z=z/||z||2; q_u=u/||u||2. Zero norm undefined/null, no epsilon. Lists and denominator do not change when members become inactive.
H2_reference: Report both new vs same-family old direction and new vs frozen S03 discovery direction; raw metric uses old-only exploration mean fixed here, normalized weighted metric uses original S03 frozen direction.
H2_count_rule: For each site/atom/metric/reference/split, denominator3families. Exclusive priority: zero_norm (normalized metric only), member_inactive (either cat or dog not active under new suffix, also old for old-pair reference), no_reference (old difference zero/undefined), same/opposite/zero_difference. Report inactive/zero_norm marginal flags separately; raw and q differences still shown even if inactive.
precision: CPU FP32 model/SAE and logsoftmax; FP64 score sum and offline analysis
stop: 24 prefix captures and24 two-candidate comparisons, then report; no extra prompts/data, feature selection, SVD, H3/H4, fitting, training or intervention
